_comment: A material AI-assisted decision system (a model whose output materially affects a customer outcome). Compiles model-risk at a raised floor, human-oversight, and monitoring controls regardless of the surrounding product type.

medium._pa2_comment: `ai-disclosure` is a CUSTOMER-facing duty, not an internal one: where AI made or materially shaped a decision about a person, the person is told so, and told the human-review path out of it. Consumer-protection disclosure duties do not stop applying because the decider was a model — this section is where that extension is written down and read by an approver.

high._runtime_comment: At high risk the model is deciding about people in production, and every guardrail this harness ships is a BUILD-time one — hooks and CI gates do not execute in the serving path. `runtime_guardrails` does not let the harness verify that a runtime control fires; it refuses to let a change ship that never chose the enforcement point. Naming it is the least the institution owes a customer whose outcome a model decides.
